description: Finished events for one sport and league in a date range (max 31 days; data from December 2025). Use the ids with get_historical_odds. To find a past match by team name use search_historical_events instead. Score periods use keys p1..pN, ft, ot and ap (older keys period1, overtime, penalties, fulltime stop on 12 November 2026).

fields.description: Optional comma-separated top-level fields to keep on each item (e.g. 'id,home,away,date,status'). Trims large responses.

maxResults.description: Optional cap on the number of items returned to you (applied after the API call).

to.description: End date in RFC3339 format, at most 31 days after from

name: get_historical_events
title: Historical events
